title: Photos
description: The Wikimedia Commons photos shown on the place and stop cards (decision 0067): for each place, or stop with no place of its own, the owner's picks in order, each with its TASL credit (title, author, source, licence). The photos keep their own licences and are not part of this data's CC BY grant.

place_id.description: The place in places.geojson, or a stop in stops.geojson with no place_ref, the photos show with.

stop_ids.description: The stops whose card shows these photos too: those whose place_ref is the place, or the stop itself.

file.description: The WebP file, relative to the site's root (site/public/).

title.description: The title on Commons (its ObjectName, else the file name).

author.description: The author as Commons credits them, as plain text.

licence.description: Public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA only (design section 3).

licence_url.description: The licence's page, or null for public domain files, which Commons gives none.

date.description: When the photo was taken, as Commons gives it, or null where Commons gives none.

commons_url.description: The file's page on Commons: the source in the credit.

alt.description: Alt text, written for this site from the title.

first_seen.description: Only where the photo's words name a place the reader meets later than its own place. Otherwise it shows with its place.
